payload.label: Printers I can use
payload.job: List the printers the person's computer can print to, and which one is the default

payload.label: Print a file
payload.job: Print a file from the person's Trillion files on a printer their computer already has (paper size, fit to page, two-sided, colour, copies), so the person never opens a print dialog
payload.description: Give file (its name in the person's files, such as /Projects/sample-card.pdf, or its identity); printer (from tool:printers; the computer's default when left out), copies, paper (the print system's size name, such as Letter, A4, Tabloid), fit (true to fit the page), sides (one-sided, two-sided-long-edge), color (color or monochrome), orientation and title when wanted. Returns printed, the printer, the job id and said. Large-format or many copies belong to a print shop (workflow:print-and-deliver).
